lastCompletedStory.title: CRITICAL: Fail-open no guard fail-closed: Bun.Transpiler.scan() nao reporta req…

nextStoryContext: COSS verification now takes a multiset union of Bun.Transpiler.scan().imports and scanImports(), preserving scan() accuracy while adding require-call findings omitted by Bun 1.3.13 without duplicating imports returned by both APIs. The CLI regression test proves a bare require("@coss/ui") in leak.cjs exits nonzero.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Current Bun docs confirm scan() and scanImports() return import path/kind metadata and describe scanImports() as the less-accurate fast path; local Bun 1.3.13 measurement confirmed only scanImports() reports require-call, so the implementation merges both result sets.
